title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling well today with no new complaints of edema, fatigue, or changes in urinary output. He has been adherent to his current regimen. He also has a history of hypertension, which is currently stable.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily, Amlodipine 5mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs are stable. Blood pressure is 128/82 mmHg. No peripheral edema is noted. Heart sounds are regular. Lungs are clear to auscultation.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 2.
2. Hypertension.

Plan
Continue current medications for hypertension and CKD. The patient will maintain a low-sodium diet. Laboratory work will be ordered to monitor renal function and electrolytes. Follow-up in 6 months.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD is presumed linked: I12.9 for CKD stage 1-4 (sequenced first), plus the N18 stage code.

distractors.why: The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
I12.0 is for stage 5 or ESRD only.
